title: gdpr.com.tr Country Factsheet
description: Two-tier bilingual schema. summary.* powers the dashboard card; details.* powers the deep-dive panel and the Markdown doc.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. TR, DE). Use EU for the umbrella entry.

iso_n3.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric, 3-digit zero-padded (e.g. 792, 276). Empty string for non-country entries.

year.description: Year the current framework entered into force.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date this factsheet was last verified.

sources.description: Authoritative URLs with short titles. Cite per-fact in details.* via inline footnote markers like [^1] or [^2].

id.description: Short ID used as footnote marker, e.g. 'kvkk-2024-amend'.

summaryTier.description: Compact fields used by the dashboard right card and chips.

lawTitle.description: Official law title in this language.

summary.description: 1–2 paragraphs framing the regime and its quirks.

maxFine.description: Current maximum administrative fine, including reference year if numeric.

detailsTier.description: Long-form, citation-bearing fields. Each subsection is a string of Markdown; footnote markers like [^kvkk-2024-amend] reference entries in sources[].

overview.description: History, place in the legal order, relationship to constitution, the personality of the regulator.

definitions.description: Personal data, special categories, controller, processor, joint controllers, etc.

obligations.description: ROPA, DPO, DPIA, accountability, vendor management.

crossBorder.description: Adequacy, SCC, BCR, derogations, recent guidance, local quirks.

enforcement.description: Cap calculation, mitigating factors, recent 2024–2026 landmark decisions.

sectoral.description: Employment, health, children's data, marketing/cookies, financial.

recentDevelopments.description: Legislative changes, regulator guidance, pending bills (last ~24 months).

openIssues.description: Optional. Pending court referrals, anticipated guidance, contested interpretations.
